thread:
Alex Chen: heads up — support reported a customer saw double billing on a single streaming request that hit a toolcall and got truncated + retried. billing shows both a provisional and a confirmed charge for overlapping tokens. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking:

Maria Gomez: ugh. can you paste the logs / request ids? is this a reconnect or a server-side retry?

Alex Chen: reconnect from client. here's the trimmed log (redacted ids):
```
2026-03-10T15:20:12Z INFO stream:start session=SID-abc123 route=router-a
2026-03-10T15:20:15Z WARN stream:recv eof toolcall_start id=TID-444
2026-03-10T15:20:16Z INFO router:fallback session=SID-abc123 -> SID-def456
2026-03-10T15:20:17Z INFO toolcall:start id=TID-444 resume=true prefix_len=178
2026-03-10T15:20:17Z INFO billing:provisional tokens=432 request_id=RID-9001
2026-03-10T15:20:20Z INFO billing:confirmed tokens=598 request_id=RID-9001
```

Samir Patel: so toolcall id stayed the same (TID-444) but session changed. weird. looks like we credited a provisional when we resumed and later issued confirmed that included the same prefix plus suffix, which would double-count the prefix.

Kevin Liu: probable root: our resume path emits `billing:provisional` when it sees a gap and then the finalization path computes confirmed by summing prefix+suffix without dedup. iirc the ledger dedupe key is session_id + toolcall_id currently, so changing session_id breaks dedupe.

Anya Kaur: that mapping used to be session-scoped to avoid cross-session poisoning. but we do allow toolcall_id reuse across resumes for sticky clients. seems we missed a case where session rotates and toolcall stays constant.

Maria Gomez: can we change dedupe key to rely on request_id (RID-9001) if present? requests include `request_id` from the API surface — cheaper than inventing heuristics.

Kevin Liu: request_id isn't always present for older clients. fallback: we could store an additional index by toolcall_id + canonical_prefix_hash so resume paths detect overlap. cheap mitigation: when we see provisional for a prefix and later confirmed that overlaps, we reconcile by subtracting overlap.

Alex Chen: reconciliation is fine long-term but we need a quick stopgap for the next deploy window. customers are pinging support.

Anya Kaur: quick mitigation proposal -> when resume occurs and session_id != session_on_provisional, mark provisional as "stale" and don't surface provisional counts to console until confirmed. so customers won't see double in the UI. backend ledger still records but we don't reflect provisional in billing summary. :mute:

Samir Patel: that hides the symptom but doesn't fix real billing. ops will hate having to do retro credits if we actually double-billed. do we know whether charges actually hit invoicing? provisional should not charge card until confirmed, right?

Alex Chen: provisional -> not billed to card. but support reported two separate line items in the console usage chart; customers thought they were charged. confusing.

Kevin Liu: okay prioritize UX fix for console (hide provisional on session mismatch) + backend reconciliation patch (dedupe by request_id when available, else overlap-detection by token-range). timeline: small UI tweak today, backend patch next week.

Maria Gomez: here's a quick SQL to find likely affected requests (feel free to run in staging):
```
SELECT r.request_id, b1.type as t1, b1.tokens as tok1, b2.type as t2, b2.tokens as tok2
FROM billing_events b1
JOIN billing_events b2 ON b1.request_id = b2.request_id
WHERE b1.type='provisional' AND b2.type='confirmed' AND b1.created_at < b2.created_at
AND (b1.session_id != b2.session_id OR b1.toolcall_id = b2.toolcall_id)
LIMIT 100;
```

Anya Kaur: can we also add a trace tag when we emit provisional: `provisional.origin=session-mismatch|resume` so queries can filter? tiny change in event schema.

Kevin Liu: fine by me. will submit a PR for the event tag + console hide patch. Samir can you own the overlap-detection algorithm design?

Samir Patel: yup I can. my idea: compute prefix_hash and store prefix_range per provisional. on confirmed, compute intersection size and decrement confirmed.tokens by overlap before persisting final ledger. need to think about corner cases (concurrent resumes, partial prefix evictions).

Alex Chen: thanks. @deploy-bot what's our deploy freeze window today?

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-10 16:00-17:00 UTC. non-critical hotfixes require oncall approval.

Maria Gomez: then plan: push console-provisional-hide as a hotfix (oncall ok?), PR incoming from Kevin. backend prefix dedupe in next week's sprint. Samir will draft RFC for overlap algorithm.

Anya Kaur: I'll add an alert to the billing dashboard that surfaces request_ids with provisional+confirmed within 30s and different sessions. dashboard tile should be visible to billing and support.

Alex Chen: perfect. thanks team. I'll loop in support with the mitigation steps. :pray:
summary: Customer saw console double-usage after stream truncated+resumed during a toolcall. Discussion covers root cause (session_id change + dedupe key), short-term UI mitigation (hide provisional on session mismatch), backend fixes (dedupe by request_id, overlap-detection by prefix range), SQL to find affected requests, and next steps (PR, RFC, dashboard alert).
